decisions: Followed lead decision (in-house STORE-only ZIP64 + crc32fast) over the brief's zip crate; Limits has no max_ratio
No mimetype entry (would invent a MIME name); first physical entry is manifest.json (enforced)
Entry names restricted to ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._-] components: removes unicode normalisation/case-fold ambiguity; non-ASCII names in foreign archives are rejected whole
Archive comment and any trailing bytes are rejected (EOCD must be last 22 bytes or follow ZIP64 record+locator)
UnsupportedVersion maps to Failure(Validation) per brief; Io, absent/unauthorized/missing asset map to Failure(Unavailable)
